security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Make PDFs smaller. Keep what matters.
bundle.longDescription: PDF Epsilon shrinks PDF files on your own computer. It downsamples and re-encodes oversized images, merges duplicates and removes clutter, while keeping text, vector drawing, links, bookmarks and forms intact.
